tracks.title: Artists
tracks.text: To perform on our stage, fill in the sheet and come fill our tent, with big songs and phat beats. We're welcoming submissions for 2027 — send your most up-to-date videos, tracks, and biog to show us where you are now as performers.
tracks.subject: 2027 Artist Application

tracks.title: Crew
tracks.text: The Chai Wallahs bar and cafe is the beating heart of our venue. We're on the hunt for eccentric dependables with plenty of patter and a positive mental attitude to join our bar crew.
tracks.subject: Joining the Chai Crew

tracks.title: Event Production
tracks.text: To discuss Chai Wallahs' involvement in your event — bar, catering, and curated stage programmes in various sized freeform tents. We're open to all suggestions and opportunities.
tracks.subject: Event Production Enquiry
